📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #277 (last_seen before this fire: 2026-06-06T12:56:12Z; last_notified_at: 2026-06-06T11:19:12Z, ~49h ago — past 24h suppression window).

DD monitor 77419271 *Unusual number of XHR errors for account* fired in #alert-frontend-errors at 12:07:11Z (2-msg group spanning 12:06:13–12:07:12Z). DD log sample (last 15m, 5 records) shows 4 distinct accounts (deltakits1, boswellwindows3, crslaboratories, dentmagicswltd), all failing the same `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` XHR with `http.status_code:0` (abort/timeout). Canonical signature.

*Playbook:* 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume vs the same window 24h ago — if delta < 20%, it's the chronic pattern (no new incident). 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath; dominant should be under `microservices.methodlocal.int` (pool-level). 3) Check `ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota` first — DNS bursts on the Windows fleet present here as Ocelot timeouts. 4) If DNS clean: identify which downstream microservice owns the slow path via Ocelot config in `ms-gateway-api/gateway/API/ocelot.*.json`. 5) Fix options: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout (cheapest, masks symptom), (b) scale microservices IIS pool / shorten recycle interval (medium), (c) profile sync-util under prod load (root, expensive).

`fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05` — 3 days post-rollback, recurrence pattern unchanged. Jira: none.

Note: account_impact.py returned `not_found` for all 4 sampled accounts (prod3/4/5 AlocetSystem unconfigured — known gap). User-count is a cluster lower bound, not a precise number.
